cache.note: a cache accelerates a run and proves nothing about it. Every hit is verified against the payload hash it is filed under, and deleting this directory changes run time, not results.

controls.name: burned_reference_target_only
controls.why: INC-V2-006 on a fixture. Only the link target moves; the compiled state cannot carry it and must not be reported as clean.

controls.name: burned_short_block_dropped
controls.why: the canonicaliser discards blocks below its minimum text length. The source changed and no unit exists to carry it.

controls.name: burned_html_href_only
controls.why: the same loss in the markup grammar, where the facet map is what catches it

controls.name: positive_prose_value_change_is_verified
controls.why: a number inside prose does reach the compiled state and must verify

controls.name: positive_heading_change_is_verified
controls.why: headings are one of the four things a compiled artifact carries

controls.name: positive_html_text_change_is_verified
controls.why: character data traceable into canonical text verifies in the markup grammar too

controls.name: negative_html_comment_change_is_ignored
controls.why: an editorial comment is declared non-semantic by the frozen policy

controls.name: adversarial_emphasis_markers_are_not_a_loss
controls.why: an instrument that scores punctuation as a lost fact produces a large alarming number that means nothing

controls.name: adversarial_trailing_whitespace_is_not_a_loss
controls.why: whitespace folds away under the frozen projection and must not register

controls.name: adversarial_structural_attribute_is_seen_not_ignored
controls.why: colspan changes which header a cell belongs to. INC-V2-010 records the old policy calling it presentation; it must not be IGNORED here.

controls.name: deletion_is_seen_on_the_side_it_happened
controls.why: a deleted region has no position in the newer revision. Scoring only the newer side would blind this protocol to whole blocks vanishing.

controls.name: unclassified_is_reachable
controls.why: the hard-failure state must be producible, or the gate that forbids it passes by construction. No natural fixture reached it; the scanner's own parse-failure span is the route, and it is exercised directly rather than claimed.

frame.order: ascending sha256 of the lineage id, fixed before any payload was read

gate_power.why_it_matters: G_SFH1_NO_SILENT_DROP compares scopes the run called complete against regions that should have blocked them. With no complete scope it passes vacuously and establishes nothing.

payload_bound.basis: compute: the span scanner is superlinear in payload size
